An RTMB-based Generalized Model for Assessing Crustacean Stocks (GMACS)

UNDER DEVELOPMENT!

When operational, rtmbGMACS will be a replacement for GMACS, the Generalized Model for Assessing Crustacean Stocks, which was developed using AD Model Builder and has been used to conduct stock assessments for crab stocks in Alaska managed by the North Pacific Fishery Management Council (NPFMC).

Collaborators

NMFS collaborators (i.e. have noaa.gov email) who are not members of the NMFS GitHub Enterprise Cloud account should complete a user request.
